import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
w['y']=w['count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL']/w.n_passages
w=w[w.year.notna()].copy();w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
print(len(w),w.late.mean())
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).y.mean().unstack()
  return (g[1]-g[0]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).y.agg(['mean','size']).unstack())
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);B=[]
gs=[x for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
for i in range(1000):
  B.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in gs])))
print(np.percentile(B,[2.5,97.5]))
for c in ['genre','origin','date_confidence']: print(pd.crosstab(w[c],w.late,normalize='columns').round(2))
print(w.groupby('late').n_editions.mean())
w['ap']=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('size');print(w.groupby('late').ap.mean())
hd=w[w.date_confidence=='high'];print('high',est(hd))
for dc in ['high','medium','low']:print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
m=smf.ols('y~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+np.log(n_editions)+np.log(ap)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':w.author_key.astype('category').cat.codes});print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'].values,m.pvalues['late'])
print(w.groupby('decade').y.mean().round(3))
print(w[(w.late==1)&(w.y>0)&(w.date_confidence=='high')].work_id.head(3).tolist())
